verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management and issue-tracking product. Having a coding agent detect and install toolchains in an execution environment falls outside that category. The evidence shows Shortcut connecting to external coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex CLI through its MCP server and API. It does not show Shortcut running an agent or execution environment that provisions dependencies, so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
